aus.claim: The refusal of a transfer request and a classification decision are both decisions in respect of which the applicant was entitled to written reasons.

evidence.quote:

  The refusal of a transfer request and a classification decision are both decisions in respect of which the applicant was entitled to written reasons.

aus.claim: Subsection 27(2) requires that a decision-maker be given all the information considered in the taking of the decision or a summary of that information, subject only to the terms of subsection 27(3).

evidence.quote: As a result, subsection 27(2) requires that he be given "all the information that was considered in the taking of the decision or a summary of that information" or "les renseignements pris en compte dans la décision, ou un sommaire de ceux-ci", subject only to the terms of subsection 27(3).

aus.claim: Subsection 27(3) provides a means whereby information may be withheld but it must be authorized by the Commissioner or his delegate.

evidence.quote: Subsection 27(3) provides a means whereby information may be withheld but it must be authorized by the Commissioner or his delegate.
